title: Sprites and Costumes
goal: A sprite is a little picture that has a job.
mascot_lines: A sprite is just a tiny picture that lives in your game.
Heroes are sprites, coins are sprites, even bad guys are sprites.
Each sprite has costumes — different looks it can switch between.
If you flip costumes really fast, the sprite looks like it's moving!

tier2.rephrase: Match each sprite to its job in the game.

tier3.nudge: Hero walks. Coin gives points. Bad guy hurts. Floor holds you up.
